pages.title: Arbor Planks
pages.text: Planks cut from the Arbor, pale and fine-grained, with faint branching lines running along their length. The wood smells of rain and seems to grow warmer when people walk across it. Nails go in easily and never split it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I split Arbor heartwood into planks for building. The grain branched instead of running straight, and every board I cut was slightly different.
$(thing)Used in$(): Arbor Planks Slab, Arbor Planks Stairs.
